description: The create-next-app 13/14 .gitignore: it ignores .env*.local only. A plain .env — where most tutorials and AI assistants put DATABASE_URL and API keys — matches no line and gets committed. The file mentions '.env' but does not ignore it, so VC014 must still fire. KNOWN GAP: VC014 accepts any line containing '.env', so '.env*.local' satisfies it. Fixing it means flagging every unmodified create-next-app 13/14 project at high severity — a product decision, not a contained rule fix.
